row.title: AIROUTER-NO-RUN-1: calls that never ran a model are free; a deprecated model is retired
row.body: Measured 2026-11-20 in airouter_calls: the code agent made 95 calls and 8 passed. 35 went to a model the platform deprecated that day (error 5028) and 14 were stopped by the spend governor before any model ran; those 49 were charged 1,561 estimated neurons, so the 8,000 neuron day cap was reached by 14:00 UTC and the executor produced no change for the rest of the day (k_self 0). Fixed in seed/worker/src/airouter.js: such a call is charged nothing, and a deprecated model is retired for 7 days (table airouter_retired) and then probed again. Tests in seed/worker/test/airoute.test.js.
